Name: Hour's Sam Portrait for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]With permission from soupdrnker/Hour, I've added compatibility for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43793]Sam Portrait[/url] to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]![/size]
[size=4]Credits for artworks involved go to Ailin, Poltergeister, and soupdrnker/Hour who all gave permission or have open perms for this mod. [/size]

[size=4]To install, download the file and allow to overwrite the original Seasonal Cute assets.[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
